reviews.title: The collar roll alone is worth every dollar
reviews.comment: I have owned oxfords from Drake's and Brooks Brothers Golden Fleece, but HENRO's 120/2 double-twisted Albini cotton is in a league of its own. The collar roll frames a tailored knit tie perfectly or stands effortlessly on its own under an unbuttoned blazer. True sartorial perfection.

reviews.title: Heirloom grade craftsmanship
reviews.comment: The genuine Troca mother-of-pearl buttons are thick and tactile. After three washes, the cotton has that coveted buttery oxford patina while the collar and cuffs remain razor sharp.

reviews.title: Phenomenal shirt, slim through chest
reviews.comment: Sublime drape and stitching. If you have broad lats or bench heavy, you may consider sizing up one notch, but for a modern tailored look it hugs without pulling.

reviews.title: Wore this throughout Southern Italy
reviews.comment: The Normandy linen breathability is incredible. It doesn't cling even in 34°C heat, and the olive hue has subtle depth that looks even better in natural daylight.

reviews.title: Unmatched drape, zero scratchiness
reviews.comment: Usually 100% linen takes weeks of washing to stop being scratchy. This was soft right out of the signature black box. The Cuban collar sits flat and relaxed.

reviews.title: Architectural and warm without bulk
reviews.comment: The 380gsm Prato wool has substantial heft. The cupro lining in the sleeves means it slips effortlessly over fine gauge cashmere rollnecks. Clean Scandinavian minimalism at its pinnacle.

reviews.title: My new staple boardroom shirt
reviews.comment: The French placket is clean and contemporary. The Supima 140/2 pinpoint has a soft, liquid-smooth sheen that commands presence in any room. The brass collar stays are a distinguished touch.

reviews.title: The softness is borderline addictive
reviews.comment: The cashmere-cotton blend feels like a whisper on the skin. You can wear it buttoned up as an elegant shirt or unbuttoned over a white supima tank. Extraordinary piece.
